name: chronosjs
description: Records what a user did in a web app as a small replay file and sends it to your telemetry service when they hit an error.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run --cwd examples/next-demo typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.e2e: bun run build && bun scripts/bundle-fixtures.ts && bun run --cwd examples/next-demo build && bun test --timeout 180000 tests/e2e
scripts.demo: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/next-demo dev
